en: You can thank me for the caution later.
FERN: Gotta say, after the whole Mewtwo fiasco?
Rock is now definitely my least favorite type.
FERN: It's nice to be able to focus on a goal,
Rather than the world ending,
Or ending the world.
It's good to have a rival to help focus too.
Thanks for dealing with it, \PN.
BENNETT: Hello, \PN.
BENNETT: It's good to see that Lin's final curse upon you was not permanent.
BENNETT: ... Are you alone?
I'm just... a little pensive since our battle, to tell you the truth.
That girl...
Her manner was rough, and she was incredibly rude,
But I cannot pretend not to understand where she was coming from.
I've been given so many opportunities that I am still working to prove myself worthy of deserving,
And I know that I’ve made improvements.
But to hear a complete stranger attack my character like that...
It hurt.
I was almost relieved to hear she treated everyone with the same... courtesy.
Not that most of them deserved it, of course--
I'm just... glad that it wasn’t only me.
I admire your patience in dealing with her, \PN.
And... I'll continue to work on improving myself.
I still have a lot to live up to, after all.
BENNETT: It's good to see that you got out of that cave all right.
I'm amazed that something like that was hidden down there.
It was... beautiful.
I haven't had much chance to make curry in a long time, so it was actually sort of fun getting to cook again.
The circumstances were just an extra creative challenge.
Even if my mother...
She's trying.
We both are.
But...
She can be a little embarrassing at times.
I expect most people feel the same about their parents, but that doesn't make it easier to handle.
Still.
It was nice, spending time with her.
And I enjoyed your company, as well.
We certainly couldn't have made such delicious curry without your help.
Take good care of that Pokémon, all right?
It was pretty cute, and I don't believe it meant any harm.
Laura's been dropping hints about a picnic...
I didn't tell her anything, but I have a feeling my mother may have been talking to her.
If she does end up having one, I think Victini might enjoy it, too.
BENNETT: I understand you took on the mantle of checking over the Belrose sisters for me.
My relief when I heard it was you was palpable.
It needed to be done, but I could not help but feel like I was condeming some other poor individual to the firing squad.
And who even could have gone? Surely not some other former Meteor.
Shelly? In the wrong mood, Saphira would eat her alive.
Julia? She and Charlotte would level the tower.
Florinia? She and Laura once got into a discussion about what mattered more to the well-being of a plant: micronutrient levels, or love?
The discussion went on for an hour before I excused myself.
When I returned six hours later, they were still going.
But surely you have good faith enough to be kindly- received...
Surely, if anyone, you...
BENNETT: Did you enjoy the tea party?
To be truthful, I was invited as well.
I had every intention of going, but when Laura was called away, I couldn't bring myself to go alone.
It just... would have felt awkward.
And as Laura was so excited, I didn't want to go when she couldn't.
I... am hoping to go next time, though.
It sounds like a relaxing time,
And I know how excited Laura is to get everyone together again.
I hope you'll come as well, of course, \PN.
BENNETT: I understand that you've been keeping busy, helping out with some of these Anomalies.
...Truth be told, I've been a little curious.
I saw some of the footage of that incident with Meloetta, back at Agate Circus.
I heard her singing.
It... sounded nice.
It's no wonder people wanted to listen.
BENNETT: ...Please don't tell anyone I said that.
At any rate, I'm glad to see you seem to be doing well.
BENNETT: I've just been catching up on the news a bit, in between Anomalies.
It's fascinating, actually.
I do hope you've been keeping well.
I know you're always trying to help everybody,
And it's admirable.
But please do remember to be careful, and put time aside to rest.
I think that's something a few people here could stand to remember, if truth be told.
But especially when you go chasing after Anomalies like you have been.
Just...
Don't push yourself too hard.
BENNETT: These days, Mother seems to be...
Lighter?
Perhaps it is nice to believe that we, even as people, never stop growing either.
BENNETT: I always imagined these clubs being a little more...
Wild?
I suppose that's only some of the company we keep though.
BENNETT: Thank you for stopping by to chat.
It's refreshing to know that I haven't completely burned every bridge.
BENNETT: I'm looking forward to our next match.
If you ever find yourself bored, I'm always open to further practice.
BENNETT: If there's anything I can do to help out, you are, of course, free to ask.
TAKA: Oh, hey, \PN.
I guess I shouldn't be surprised to see you here, huh?
You're always doing this kind of stuff.
Me? I'm not sure, exactly.
All that-- back in the past-- was... a lot.
I guess I just thought I'd drop by and see if I could help.
Sounds like there's a lot of these Anomalies running around still.
So... hi.
I guess I'll see you around.
TAKA: It's still kinda surreal, having gotten to see the future like that...
I'm still trying to process it all.
The idea that everything will be okay even if we don't fight the world and everyone to make it happen...
That's, uh...
Fresh.
TAKA: I'm glad Ace is back.
I felt... horrible about what happened.
I mean, I didn't even know the details.
I just had a feeling...
That it was my fault.
Then again, I feel that way a lot.
Oops.
Uh, the point is, thanks for bearing with everyone long enough to bring them back.
I missed them.
TAKA: I don't exactly know what happened with Luna, back at the sanctum...
But somehow I get the feeling I missed out on something.
And yet, I have no idea what.
...Maybe that's just the anxiety.
Or maybe I'm right, and anxiety makes me second guess myself?
...Maybe I need a snack.
Do they have lemon cake at the bar over there or anything?
I used to love lemon pound cake.
TAKA: It's... kinda weird, seeing all these people here now.
Elias...
Blake...
It's a bit weird, to be honest.
Nobody's fighting, and everyone seems pretty relaxed.
It's kind of nice.
TAKA: Luna seems... a little bit different?
From before.
Did something happen?
I mean, I know it's not really my business...
...I guess it just makes me a little nervous to see Elias trying to force things to remain a certain way.
We're better off without the past coming back to us.
TAKA: I've never been much for clubs.
Usually I just hide on the sidelines, and... hope someone thinks I'm interesting.
Uh... I guess that's you, huh?
TAKA: I know it's never entirely over, but...
The chance to breathe is nice.
TAKA: Father would have killed me if he knew I was wasting time in this kind of place.
I guess I'm glad I can at least try to relax here.
TAKA: You don't have to worry about me.
I'm just another guy now.
TAKA: Oh hey, it's you.
Man, I know you're always poking into things,
And punching things that get in your way,
But even I never expected what happened back there.
No, I'm not even gonna ask.
Just... thanks for breaking me out of that.
You and Luna both.
Y'know, I always thought it was some kind of weird dream.
When we were kids, I mean.
But.. you were really there, huh?
Man, time stuff is weird.
Anyway... thanks again.
I'm glad I could be back.
To see all this.
TAKA: I'm glad we rescued Ace.
They're pretty far up there with you in the category of people I feel I owe a lot to.
Despite them not being much older, I feel like they kinda helped raise me.
Now I think I returned the favor.
I'm grateful to have the opportunity to offer things back to others.
You and them both.
TAKA: The sanctum is better off burnt.
There was history there,
But true to Sirius' methods, it was only ever used to control people.
There was religion there,
But it stopped being something people chose to have faith in, and started being something they were demanded to follow.
We're better off leaving it behind.
Make way for new growth, and all of that.
The memories are the same.
TAKA: Man, this place is loud.
I don't really mind, though.
I guess you're still running around dealing with those Anomalies, huh?
Maybe I'll join you at some point.
TAKA: Say...
I'm only guessing at this, but...
You picked up my Chatot, didn't you?
I wasn't sure what happened to it, after everything.
...Is there any chance I could see the little guy?
TAKA: ...Hm?
TAKA: Ah, you kept him safe after all.
Both of you did.
Hey there, little guy.
I missed you too.
Thanks for looking after \PN for me.
Hanging in there?
...Why don't you stick with \PN just a little longer?
Don't worry, I won't be far.
But my attention's due elsewhere besides battling, and they might still need your help.
You already know you're in good hands.
Both of you.
TAKA: It doesn't have to be right now, of course.
I'm sure you're busy.
Or just need to go grab him, right?
TAKA: Luna told me that she made some degree of peace with Elias.
I'm happy for her.
I won't have the chance to do that, so I'm glad that she is taking the opportunity she's been given.
Neither of us want to return to the way things are, but acceptance of the past is a necessary step on the path of prevention.
TAKA: Thanks for stopping by to chat.
TAKA: I love the warm atmosphere of this place.
TAKA: What do you say we visit the desert again some time?
Just for nostalgia's sake.
It shouldn't be so bad once there's no more maniacal god-children to hide from.
TAKA: I don't think I'm into dancing.
Not this kind.
But maybe I'd enjoy taking proper lessons.
Would you consider being my partner on the floor someday?
BLAKE: Yo.
Been a bit, huh?
Before the Ametrine stuff, I mean.
That was pretty awesome.
Don't get me wrong, if that thing shows up again I'm freezing its ass, but...
It was kinda fun.
Anyway, I'm just chillin'.
Still not sure if that whole "playing a hero" thing is my style,
But it does beat the alternative.
BLAKE: Yo, I do have to thank you for one thing--
Bringing Terra back.
She's my Call of Shooting partner.
It's been lame, trying to find randos to play with.
It's nice to get back to beating the noobs with someone who knows what they're doing.
Yo, fam, you should totally try playing!
If you ever do, let me know.
BLAKE: Man.
I know this is a nightclub, but you'd think they'd have more drink selection?
They don't even have Citrine Dew?
What's wrong with a place where they don't even have Citrine Dew!
The music's pretty cool, though, I'll admit.
BLAKE: Bro, you wanna do shots with me?
BLAKE: Yo, Elias actually has some wicked stories, you just gotta get him a few drinks first.
BLAKE: Hey, hey, hey--
You see Cal looking bored enough, tell him I've got thirty bucks that says I can double his drinks and still beat him in Call of Shooting.
BLAKE: Bruh, you still finding legends out there?
Teabag 'em for me!
CAL: \PN? You're back?
But, how?
I was told that you had... turned into the moon?
And, like, that's rough, buddy.
But if you're here, will the moon never shine again?
...No, I suppose that's a worthwhile trade for now.
I support your choices, no matter what may happen.
CAL: Maybe it's a misguided judgment, but...
I still want to believe it was the right thing to do.
Uh, I mean, to pass that report onto the Nightclub.
I mean, you've seen just how much she's been pressuring herself with trying to live up to Kiki, rather than...
CAL: I hadn't expected the little guy to... well, you know.
I've... been thinking about it a lot.
Keep waiting for guilt over causing her even more trouble to sink back in.
I mean, it's all I felt about her for the longest time.
I think I'm... admittedly just grateful that it went well enough in the end.
...Not that it couldn't have handled the situation a bit more nicely, pushing her as hard as it did.
But I'm glad it could be there to help her see that she's been enough all along.
You know?
CAL: It's nice to be able to breathe, a bit.
Honestly, since Blake's been back around, it's felt kind of... weird.
Not bad, just...
Before everything with Heatran, the last few times we saw each other we were at odds.
And even before that, he just always insisted that he didn't care.
I... probably shouldn't have believed him, in hindsight, but that's in the past now.
It's just... bizarre.
I keep waiting for the other shoe to drop.
But in his own way, I really do think he wants to help now.
And as weird as it is...
I'm glad.
CAL: Hey, \PN?
I'm glad you're still here.
To be honest, I saw the moon out last night, and I was wondering...
But I'm glad you didn't go back up there permanently.
CAL: We should have a rematch sometime.
I don't want to neglect my battling.
My Pokémon deserve better than that.
CAL: I'm glad things are settling somewhat back to normal.
A better normal.
CAL: Hm?
CAL: Are you doing all right, \PN?
LUMI: Oh, it is you!
I'm so glad you decided to rejoin us after all!
EVE: Your face looks spotless, by the way.
Is this some new kind of plastic surgery, or did you use a different healing technique?
LUMI: Eve, that's rude!
LUMI: He probably doesn't wanna talk about it!
LUMI: She probably doesn't wanna talk about it!
LUMI: They probably don't wanna talk about it!
EVE: Even so, if it is the latter-- I'm willing to accept the social faux pas if there's any chance that whatever it was could help you...
... But \PN seems confused.
To clarify, we were told that in the final battle, a stray explosion left your face horribly disfigured...
... And so, although you were safe, you had chosen to live reclusively so that no one had to see the unfortunate aftermath.
LUMI: Which you never should have had to do in the first place!
If people didn't accept you after what you did for them-- no matter how you looked-- then they're not worth your time, \PN!
But we'll always be there for you no matter what!
EVE: I am beginning to suspect I should have scrutinized the source of this information more in the first place...
You were actually okay all along, weren't you?
LUMI: Huh?
EVE: No matter.
You must've had your reasons for your absence. It's not our business to pry.
Yours is a welcome return nonetheless.
EVE: Ah, \PN, I hoped you might stop by for a moment.
Flora actually left us one additional item of note before she left.
I can only assume she was too proud to give it to us in person, since I just found it lying in our house with a note...
But apparently this Misdreavus is one from her home region.
She thought either of us might enjoy using it.
I don't have a particular interest. Do you want it?
EVE: Just as well.
Here you go.
EVE: While I am curious to see how it develops differently, I have much to focus on now.
Best regards with it, and thank you again for your help.
I'm sure dealing with her was not exactly easy...
EVE: I suppose I can hang onto it for the time being.
Do let me know if you change your mind.
EVE: I trust you're taking care of the little one Flora left?
I'm sure it's in excellent hands.
To be honest, I’m glad she’s gone.
She may have been respectable in her goals-- whatever they really were--
But I think she was the most unpleasant person I've ever had to deal with.
She was certainly... something.
I'm still not sure she can be trusted, honestly.
But... I did everything I could to impress upon her the dangers of the PULSE machines,
And all I can do is hope that she understood.
I'm glad, at least, that Lumi didn’t run into her.
I am so very tired of violence, and of being in the middle of things.
And even in Meteor, things were normally settled with Pokémon battles.
I've never actually... punched anyone.
But if that girl treated my sister the way she treated everyone else--
She might have been my first.
But let's not waste time with hypotheticals.
She's gone, and some of the ideas she left might be very helpful.
I'll fill you in if I get any ideas.
In the meantime, take care of that Pokémon, \PN.
Take care of that Pokémon, \PN.
Thank you, once again, for helping.
EVE: About the Shaymin cure...
It's going...
...Well.
I'm still not entirely sure how to understand it.
Just... relieved.
EVE: Lumi told me about seeing Meloetta up at the Battle Wheel.
It sounds like it was quite the event.
Honestly, I'm just glad she had a good time.
She talked for ages about it.
About seeing all the sights, and about the performance,
And about how much fun it was to battle like that.
She's really been growing lately, and I'm so happy for her.
Proud of her.
I... I know she still worries.
I won't pretend that I don't worry, too.
But it's so good to see her like this, having fun.
So tell Meloetta thanks for me, won't you?
EVE: That reminds me, I'd like to have a word with that Santiago fellow, when I get the chance...
EVE: You know, I'm really more of a coffee-drinker, myself.
But I don't mind the idea of tea parties.
Coffee parties sound ridiculous.
Perhaps I am open to being converted.
EVE: Thank you for making Lumi smile.
EVE: I wonder what the New World can still hold for us...
EVE: It's difficult to resist the impulse to feel like I should be studying, instead of resting in a place like this.
But what good is working if you don't allow yourself to enjoy the rewards?
EVE: As you were.
ZERO: Did you want to hear about this one again?
ZERO: \PN.
Uh, for whatever it's worth, I'm glad you got through that mess at Labradorra.
And all the stuff after it...
It feels weird to know that the reason so many weird things had to happen to us just... no longer exists, but...
It's better this way, I guess.
Uh, look, I'm not here to embarrass myself by rambling at you forever again!
There's Legendaries running amok out there, right?
We're both here to help get that mess under control, right?
Let's focus on those!
I've got a report here about, uhh...
Somewhere around Route 2, looks like a gate opened up.
No damage or strange Pokémon reported yet, but with one of those things appearing, it's only a matter of time.
Uh, so, should I mark you down for the case?
ZERO: You got it, boss.
Remember, it's around Route 2.
I think I heard something about it being in a cave?
Oh, and also, I think one of the people who lives nearby already went in to check it out.
So, uh, don't be surprised if you run into them or something.
That'll be about it.
ZERO: No...?
Uh, yeah, something like that would just be below you, of course.
We can take care of this.
In fact there's already someone else on the case.
Don't you worry about it.
ZERO: Need a reminder?
Route 2! There's a gate that opened somewhere!
A local went in to check it out already...
Well, not just any local, but...
You got this!
ZERO: What, you need to find someone who reads braille?
Obviously there would be Elias, but no one's heard from him since everything went down.
Hey, actually-- when we were hustling the city still, I remember hearing about a blind girl living in the Coral Ward?
Kicked up some kind of fuss by offering a quiz to prove how she was better than sighted people.
Maybe she's still around?
ZERO: We've got a new mission on deck, and this one carries a special request for you specifically, \PN.
Apparently on a recent mission, Aya and Hardy came across a couple old artifacts.
It turns out, these orbs and their likeness tend to be...  uh, "volatile" is the word they used.
Adrienn put in a word saying they'd like you in particular to help out on a mission to get these artifacts to safety.
Something something, "as the champion"...
That sound good to you?
ZERO: Great.
...Wasn't really sure what I'd tell Mx. Adrienn if you said "No" for sure.
Anyway, they asked to meet you at Grandview Station.
Head over there as soon as you can.
ZERO: Oh.
Uh, geez, well-- I guess that's okay for right now, I'll...
Hold off on giving a final answer in case you change your mind?
Yeah...
ZERO: Adrienn has asked to meet you at Grandview Station.
Apparently your help as the champion has been requested on a matter of some sensitive artifacts.
I don't really know the details, but they should be able to brief you over there.
ZERO: We've got a new report in...
Uhh, you may not like this.
Some folks in Calcenon have been reporting flickering power and other electrical disturbances in both their city and Labradorra.
So, it's either an Electric Type Anomaly... Or there's something down in the LCCC.
If it's the latter, I have a feeling there's one spot in particular that should be checked ASAP...
From the... Labradorra entrance, that is...
This may not be pleasant.
Should I mark you down for it?
ZERO: No one better for it than you, I suppose.
You take care down there.
I never was a fan of what they had in that place.
If it shows up again, make sure you fix it up real good.
ZERO: Can't say I blame you for not wanting in on this one.
Not that anyone else does, but...
...Yeah.
ZERO: There are reports about power issues coming from the LCCC.
You'll need to go down there and check it out.
Personally, I feel like there's one obvious hotspot to check-- albeit an unpleasant one.
From the... Labradorra entrance, you know?
Good luck.
ZERO: \PN, I'm glad you showed up now.
I don't know what's gotten into her all of a sudden, but Eve's getting ideas again.
She's trying to build the PULSE again.
And she's going on about finally making the cure...
I don't think I gotta explain why I'm concerned right now.
For obvious reasons, I don't wanna go anywhere near all that,
But I'm worried.
Do you think you could check in on them for me?
ZERO: A thousand thanks.
Eve told me she needs some particular ingredients for her theorized cure, so she's been looking for them in New World zones.
The latest one popped up in Seacrest's own garden.
I'm surprised the old coot didn't have a heart attack on the spot when he heard.
Guess there might still be time though...
Anyway, Eve was just rushing off to that one when she mentioned having completed the redesign.
Start there.
And... maybe hurry.
ZERO: I can't say I don't understand.
You might've been the best person for the job, but I'll ask someone else.
I wonder who...
ZERO: Eve hurried off to a New World gate to find ingredients for her newest attempt at a cure...
She hauled off her latest device to the gate that spawned in Seacrest's garden...
...Someone should probably go check on her.
ZERO: You found a ghost at the meteor site?
And it told you they sealed a creature deep within Byxbysion?
Good lead, but be careful. If the creature had to be sealed away, it must be dangerous.
ZERO: Unfortunately, there's still nothing on our radars.
ZERO: ...Ah, hi again.
So, we've got a new situation...
ZERO: ...Ah, hi. As usual, I'm glad you came around.
I wanted to, uh, thank you.
For helping Lumi.
I heard it's going well...
That's good.
If anything happened to her or Eve, I...
Well, I'm not sure who I'd be.
...Uh, so anyway.
We've got a new situation...
...And that situation is the total lack of situations.
Everything's gone totally dark.
Either whatever's making the Anomalies has gone totally silent, or it's doing something to hide itself.
Either Lin's gone totally silent, or she's doing something to cover her tracks.
I'm not sure which I like the idea of better, but we haven't been able to detect a single Anomaly since the last round of things.
...Anyway, sorry, I don't have anything for you.
Not for now.
We had one small blip of something over at the meteor site, where you found Deoxys.
But we didn't find anything else there when we sent someone to Citrine to check, and it's unlikely something would reappear there so soon anyway.
Maybe something will change if we wait long enough, but for now we're either grounded or flying blind.
Hunting Lin down is just gonna have to wait.
LUMI: From the sounds of it, you've been helping out a lot around here!
I know everyone really appreciates it.
LUMI: Actually, there was something I was hoping to ask about that!
I heard some people talking about Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres being sighted around Reborn!
Have you seen them?
LUMI: That's amazing!
LUMI: Oh... I guess I misheard.
I've always loved stories about them- especially Articuno. It's so graceful and elegant!
I'd really love to see it for myself someday.
\PN, if you ever manage to make friends with Articuno, do you think you could bring it here? I'd really love to meet it!
LUMI: Now that we've come this far, I'm starting to have thoughts!
Dangerous thoughts!
Thoughts like, what kind of things do I want to do in the future?
Before I always kinda held myself back from thinking about those things.
Because, if I never get the chance to do it, well...
...I dunno!
Now that I'm saying it out loud, isn't that kind of silly?
I mean, I may as well at least have thought about it before!
Maybe I'll go traveling someday!
I wanna see all the different regions!
Nowhere too hot though, okay?
LUMI: Hey, is it just me or does Noel seem... different?
Ever since the tea party?
I'm kinda worried about him.
Not that I don't trust him to take care of himself!
But he doesn't always have to take care of himself, himself.
LUMI: Oh, \PN! Did you ever end up finding that Articuno?
LUMI: Oh...
LUMI: Oh, it's wonderful!
Hi there, Articuno!
LUMI: Thank you so much for showing me, \PN!
Take good care of it!
LUMI: Oh... that's okay!
Let me know if you find it!
LUMI: Okay, so it's easy to say which Pokémon would be the best dancer,
But which Pokémon would be the SILLIEST dancer?
I'm thinking Spinda.
Or maybe a Muk?
Wait-- no!
I've got it:
Ditto, untransformed.
LUMI: Have you tried the fizzy drinks here?
They mix them up with cream!
LUMI: You know, I kinda liked my odds against you in Labradorra...
Maybe you should watch out!
LUMI: We should go sledding sometime!
You just gotta find a good slope around the mountain, and then wheeeeeeee~
RANDALL: There's been multiple reports of, uh, what's they were...
RANDALL: Well, a huff, puff and a how-di-do-di to you, partner!
I'd say I never imagined to see you in a place like this, but in truths, it's myself I'd never have imagined to be here.
These types of places ain't no good for readin', you feel?
If the noise weren't distraction enough, the lights 'll make it near impossible.
But I done heard abouts all them leggy Pokémon around and I figured, y'all folks might be a bit short of hand.
You can call me a baseball player, cuz I'm pitchin' in!
Now, let's get down to that business.
There's been multiple reports of, uh, what's they were...
Anemones, right?
Multiple Anemones have been reported around Route 1 and the Aventurine Woods areas.
